### Mastercard Announces Annual Meeting Results


June 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/479285134/files/doc_news/Mastercard-Announces-Annual-Meeting-Results-2026.pdf)


PURCHASE, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE:MA) announced the results of its annual meeting of stockholders, held today.


At the meeting:


- The full slate of 11 directors was elected for a one-year term to expire at the next annual meeting of stockholders
- The compensation for the company’s executive officers was approved on an advisory basis
- The appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers, LLP as the company's independent registered public accounting firm for 2026 was ratified
- Neither of the two stockholder proposals were approved by the voters


When final voting results are available, they will be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on a[Form 8-K](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov%2Fcgi-bin%2Fbrowse-edgar%3FCIK%3DMA%26action%3Dgetcompany%26owner%3Dexclude&esheet=54555485&newsitemid=20260616767839&lan=en-US&anchor=Form+8-K&index=1&md5=45274a25fffbbc202d37dacc9886818c) and posted on the[Investor Relations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.mastercard.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54555485&newsitemid=20260616767839&lan=en-US&anchor=Investor+Relations&index=2&md5=d2ac08d14b15389cedbb35b940a289ce) section of Mastercard.com.
